item.text:
The design and scorer now treat G consistently: a recovery counts as correct only against the gate-accounted marks, with W and H included; G is reported separately when both first readers fail it. A counted recovery should not be described as wholly sound if its G fails. [Design]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/DESIGN-A2.md:53), [scorer]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/probe_score.py:235)

The probe remains a comparison of A2 as a whole against the frozen request, and the $0.50 reservation limit may stop it before completion. The G report counts cases both readers fail; disagreements remain in their raw readings.
